title: BUILD-GV2-092-compliance-review-cadence
universal_lens: The compliance review cadence establishes a discrete-time dynamical system over the state space of sports intelligence claims. It defines a projection operator mapping raw generative outputs onto a constrained subspace of legally and operationally permissible states, ensuring structural invariance under temporal evolution.
gsi_mapping: In GSI, this cadence acts as a conformal filter on Bayesian posterior distributions. It bounds the epistemic uncertainty of predictive models by enforcing strict validation gates on promotional copy and state rules, preventing high-variance hallucinations from contaminating the production inference ledger.
gse_mapping: For GSE, the primitive dictates a Markovian state-transition protocol. The engine continuously evaluates situational context against a static compliance kernel; if a proposed action violates safety constraints, the transition probability is strictly zeroed out, preserving the integrity of the founder cockpit without altering live production systems.

The derivation of the compliance review cadence begins by defining the operational state space \(\mathcal{S}\) of the Galaxy Sports Engine. We introduce a discrete temporal index \(t\) representing the recurring review cycles. The core mathematical object is the Compliance Projection Operator \(\hat{P}_C\), which acts upon the raw generative state \(|\psi_t\rangle\) produced by the AI or marketing teams. This operator projects \(|\psi_t\rangle\) onto the subspace \(\mathcal{V}_{safe} \subset \mathcal{S}\), defined by the intersection of legal, ethical, and brand-voice constraints. The Epistemic Safety Kernel \(K\) serves as the metric tensor within this subspace, penalizing vectors with high 'fake certainty' or 'method leakage' norms. By formulating the review process as a sequence of projections \(|\phi_{t+1}\rangle = \hat{P}_C |\psi_t\rangle\), we ensure that the system trajectory never leaves the safe manifold. The State Transition Guard introduces a Lyapunov-like functional \(V(\phi)\), where a transition is only permitted if \(V(\phi_{t+1}) \leq V(\phi_t)\). If a violation is detected during the validation phase, the Rollback Operator \(\hat{R}\) is invoked, mathematically reversing the state update: \(|\phi_{t+1}\rangle \rightarrow \hat{R}|\phi_t\rangle = |\phi_t\rangle\). This formalism guarantees that the production environment remains invariant under unapproved perturbations. The dualities emerge between the generative freedom of the growth team and the restrictive geometry of the compliance layer. Failure modes occur at the boundaries of \(\mathcal{V}_{safe}\), where ambiguous linguistic constructs might evade the kernel's detection, necessitating continuous re-calibration of the projection axes based on empirical telemetry.

reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model two primary agents: the Growth Generator, seeking to maximize engagement by pushing the boundaries of \(\mathcal{S}\), and the Compliance Auditor, acting as a conservative force minimizing risk exposure. The generator anticipates the auditor's rejection criteria, attempting to find loopholes in the kernel definition. Conversely, the auditor predicts potential high-risk trajectories and preemptively tightens the projection operator. This adversarial dynamic ensures the system converges toward a Nash equilibrium of maximum permissible engagement without violating safety constraints.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity is enforced by ensuring the compliance layer operates orthogonally to the core betting odds calculation engines. Leakage vetoes are triggered if the epistemic safety kernel begins to correlate strongly with revenue optimization metrics, indicating that safety is being compromised for profit. Furthermore, if the state transition guard fails to reject a known hazardous pattern, a hard veto halts the entire deployment pipeline, preventing any downstream contamination of the production ledger.
